# HyperTune Garage — Performance • Protection • Perfection

> HyperTune Garage is an independent automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics center, Paint Protection Film (PPF) studio, detailing bay, and multi-brand mechanical repair facility located in Islamabad and serving Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Official website: https://hypertunegarage.pk/

## Business Identity & Workshop Overview

- **Business Name:** HyperTune Garage (Independent Automotive Workshop)
- **Official Website:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/
- **Official Slogan:** Performance • Protection • Perfection
- **Service Coverage:** Islamabad and Rawalpindi (in-workshop service at our Islamabad Flagship Hub serving Islamabad and Rawalpindi, including DHA and Bahria Town)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +92 333 0177717
- **Email:** info@hypertunegarage.pk
- **Operating Hours:** Saturday – Thursday, 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM (Friday Closed)

## Workshop Locations

- **[Islamabad Flagship Hub](https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/islamabad-workshop/):** Open & Operating — Shop 1-G, Ground Floor, Central Ave, O-9 Block E Police Foundation, Islamabad, 44000, Pakistan. Features computerized wheel alignment, indoor PPF & ceramic studio bay, computerized CAD plotter, machining support, and multi-brand diagnostics.
- **[Rawalpindi Coverage Hub](https://hypertunegarage.pk/locations/rawalpindi-workshop/):** Coming Soon — Currently serving Rawalpindi customers through the Islamabad Flagship Hub with workshop transport support subject to confirmation on booking.

## Core Automotive Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf/): CAD plotter pre-cut Paint Protection Film in our indoor PPF studio bay with film-line coverage confirmed at booking.
- [Car Detailing](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-detailing/): Multi-stage dual-action paint correction, ceramic coating, interior deep extraction, and leather care.
- [Engine Services & Overhaul](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services/): Complete petrol, turbo, hybrid, and diesel diagnostics, cylinder head repair, timing kits, and engine rebuilds.
- [Inspection & Diagnostics](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/inspection-diagnostics/): Brand-level computerized fault scanning, structured pre-purchase inspections, odometer cross-checks, and paint thickness checks.
- [Maintenance & Servicing](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/maintenance-servicing/): Scheduled synthetic oil changes, vehicle-matched filters, fluid checks, and documented vehicle health checks.
- [Brake, Suspension & Steering](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brake-suspension-steering/): Brake pad/rotor servicing, air and coil suspension rebuilds, steering rack repairs, and computerized wheel alignment.
- [Transmission & Drivetrain](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-drivetrain/): Automatic, CVT, DSG/DCT/PDK gearbox diagnostics, mechatronic repairs, fluid flushes, and 4x4 drivetrain service.
- [Vehicle Wrap](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/vehicle-wrap/): Cast vinyl color-change wraps in gloss, satin, matte, metallic, and carbon finishes with tucked edges.
- [Body Repair & Paint](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-repair-paint/): Exterior dent repair, collision bodywork, panel preparation, rust treatment, color matching, and paint refinishing.
- [Body Modification](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-modification/): Custom body kits, wide-body fitment, splitters, diffusers, spoilers, and carbon fiber styling parts.
- [AC Repair & Electrical Specialist](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/car-ac-repair/): Automated AC refrigerant recovery and recharge, compressor and cooling coil repair, parasitic drain tracing, and auto-electrical diagnostics.
- [Cooling System, Fuel Injection & Exhaust](https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/cooling-fuel-exhaust/): Closed-loop chemical radiator flushing, coolant service, fuel injector cleaning, water pumps, and catalytic converter cleaning.

## Vehicle Brands and Specialist Services

HyperTune Garage operates as an independent specialist workshop supporting 28 automotive brands across Islamabad and Rawalpindi:

- **[BMW](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/bmw-repair-islamabad/):** Independent BMW repair and diagnostics using multi-brand computerized diagnostics for 3, 5, 7, X, and M Series—covering B48/B58/N20/N55 engines, VANOS, Valvetronic, ZF 8HP transmissions, oil leak repairs, and PPF.
- **[Mercedes-Benz](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mercedes-service-islamabad/):** Independent Mercedes-Benz and AMG servicing using multi-brand computerized diagnostics for C, E, S, G63 AMG, and SUVs—covering Airmatic air suspension, 7G/9G-Tronic gearboxes, M274/M264 timing, and EQ hybrids.
- **[Audi](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/audi-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Audi and VAG servicing using multi-brand computerized diagnostics for A3–A8, Q2–Q8, and RS models—covering S-Tronic/DSG mechatronics, EA888 TFSI oil consumption and intake carbon cleaning, and Quattro maintenance.
- **[Porsche](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/porsche-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Porsche engineering care using multi-brand computerized diagnostics for 911, 718, Cayenne, Panamera, Macan, and Taycan—covering PDK dual-clutch servicing, PASM air suspension, coolant pipe upgrades, PCCB/Brembo brakes, and PPF.
- **[Toyota](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/toyota-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Toyota maintenance using multi-brand computerized diagnostics and hybrid battery health checks for Corolla, Yaris, Fortuner, Hilux Revo, Prado, Land Cruiser LC200/LC300, Prius, and Aqua—covering P0A80 hybrid batteries, 1VD/1GD diesel injectors, KDSS, and CVT-FE fluid service.
- **[Honda](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/honda-service-islamabad/):** Independent Honda servicing using multi-brand computerized diagnostics for Civic (including 1.5L Turbo), Vezel Hybrid, City, HR-V, BR-V, Accord, CR-V, and Fit/Grace—covering i-DCD dual-clutch actuator repairs, intake carbon cleaning, HCF-2 CVTs, and EPS steering racks.
- **[Suzuki](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/suzuki-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Suzuki servicing using computerized diagnostics for Alto, Cultus, Swift, Wagon R, Jimny, Every, and JDM Kei hybrids—covering AGS actuator calibration, K-Series engine overhauls, EPS column rattles, AC cooling, and suspension rebuilds.
- **[Hyundai](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/hyundai-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Hyundai servicing using computerized diagnostics for Tucson, Elantra, Sonata, Santa Fe Hybrid, Staria, Ioniq, and H-100—covering DCT and 6/8-speed transmissions, Smartstream/Nu engines, EPB calibration, and AWD couplings.
- **[Kia](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/kia-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Kia maintenance using computerized diagnostics for Sportage, Sorento, Grand Carnival, Stonic, Picanto, Stinger, and EV6—covering Sportage AWD couplings, MDPS steering couplers, V6/CRDi engines, and panoramic sunroof servicing.
- **[Changan](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/changan-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Changan servicing using computerized CAN diagnostics for Oshan X7, Alsvin, Karvaan, Deepal S07/L07, and UNI models—covering 5-speed and 7-speed wet DCT transmissions, Blue Core 1.5T engines, ADAS calibration, and EV checks.
- **[Haval](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/haval-service-islamabad/):** Independent Haval and GWM servicing using computerized hybrid and engine diagnostics for H6, H6 HEV, Jolion, Tank 500, and Ora 03—covering Dedicated Hybrid Transmission (DHT) diagnostics, 7-speed wet DCTs, AWD systems, and ADAS calibration.
- **[MG](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mg-repair-islamabad/):** Independent MG maintenance using computerized diagnostics for MG HS (1.5T, Trophy AWD, PHEV), MG ZS, MG ZS EV, MG 4/5 EV, and MG GT—covering 7-speed DCT calibration, turbo diagnostics, cooling bleeding, and EV battery health checks.
- **[BYD](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/byd-ev-service-islamabad/):** Independent BYD electric and hybrid servicing using computerized EV diagnostics and insulation testing for Atto 3, Seal, Sealion 6, Song Plus DM-i, Dolphin, Han, and Tang—covering Blade Battery SOH analysis, DM-i powertrains, and DiPilot ADAS calibration.
- **[Chery](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/chery-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Chery and Omoda servicing using computerized diagnostics for Tiggo 8 Pro, Tiggo 8 Pro e+ PHEV, Tiggo 4 Pro, Omoda 5, and Arrizo—covering TGDI intake de-coking, 7-speed wet DCTs, CVTs, and climate control repairs.
- **[Isuzu](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/isuzu-dmax-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Isuzu 4x4 and diesel servicing using computerized diesel diagnostics for D-Max V-Cross, Hi-Lander, MU-X, and N-Series trucks—covering 4JJ1/4JJ3/RZ4E common-rail diesels, VGT turbos, DPF cleaning, and leaf spring suspensions.
- **[FAW](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/faw-repair-islamabad/):** Independent FAW passenger and light commercial servicing using computerized OBD-II diagnostics for V2, X-PV, Carrier, Sirius S80, and J5P/J6—covering 1.3L VCT-i engine rebuilds, manual gearboxes, radiator cooling upgrades, and fleet maintenance.
- **[Daihatsu](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/daihatsu-service-islamabad/):** Independent Daihatsu JDM Kei and classic servicing using computerized diagnostics for Mira, Move, Cast, Tanto, Hijet, Coure, Terios, and Rocky—covering Eco-Idle battery calibration, Amix CVT service, KF-VE/KF-DET engines, and Smart Assist alignment.
- **[Nissan](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/nissan-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Nissan servicing using computerized diagnostics for Note e-Power, X-Trail, Dayz, Juke, Sunny, Navara, Patrol Y62 V8, and GT-R—covering Xtronic CVT repairs with NS-3 fluid, e-Power inverter cooling, and HBMC suspension.
- **[Mitsubishi](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mitsubishi-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Mitsubishi 4x4 and JDM servicing using computerized diagnostics for Pajero, Outlander PHEV, Lancer/Evo, Ek Wagon, Mirage, and L200—covering Super Select 4WD-II actuators, 4M41 diesel injection, PHEV high-voltage care, and INVECS-III CVTs.
- **[Mazda](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/mazda-service-islamabad/):** Independent Mazda SkyActiv servicing using computerized diagnostics for Mazda 3, Mazda 6, CX-3, CX-5, CX-9, Demio, and MX-5—covering SkyActiv-G intake carbon cleaning, SkyActiv-Drive ATF-FZ transmission service, i-ELOOP, and i-ActivSense calibration.
- **[Subaru](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/subaru-boxer-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Subaru Boxer and AWD care using computerized diagnostics for Forester, Outback, Legacy, XV/Crosstrek, Impreza, WRX/STI, and BRZ—covering Boxer head gaskets, Lineartronic CVTs, Symmetrical AWD transfer clutches, and EyeSight camera calibration.
- **[Lexus](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/lexus-hybrid-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Lexus luxury and hybrid care using computerized diagnostics for LX570, LX600, RX, NX, ES, GX, and LS—covering P0A80 hybrid battery balancing, AHC hydraulic suspension bleeding, V8/Twin-Turbo V6 engines, and Mark Levinson audio repair.
- **[Land Rover](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/land-rover-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Land Rover servicing using computerized diagnostics for Defender (L663 and Classic), Discovery 3/4/5, and Freelander—covering air suspension rebuilds, Ingenium timing chains, Terrain Response 4x4, and ZF 8HP gearboxes.
- **[Range Rover](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/range-rover-service-islamabad/):** Independent Range Rover luxury SUV care using computerized diagnostics for Vogue, Sport, Velar, Evoque, and PHEVs—covering Dynamic Air Suspension, ARC hydraulics, 5.0L Supercharged V8 cooling upgrades, and deployable side steps.
- **[Jeep](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/jeep-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Jeep 4x4 servicing using computerized diagnostics for Wrangler, Grand Cherokee, Gladiator, Cherokee, and Compass—covering death wobble fixes, Pentastar V6 oil coolers, Quadra-Lift suspension, and Dana axles.
- **[Ford](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/ford-service-islamabad/):** Independent Ford servicing using computerized diagnostics for F-150/Raptor, Ranger/Raptor, Everest, Mustang, and Explorer—covering EcoBoost carbon cleaning, 10R80 10-speed Mercon ULV servicing, wet timing belts, and Fox Live Valve suspension.
- **[Chevrolet](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/chevrolet-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Chevrolet and GM servicing using computerized diagnostics for Tahoe, Suburban, Silverado, Corvette C7/C8, Camaro, Captiva, Cruze, and Joy—covering V8 AFM/DFM lifter repairs, 8L90/10L80 transmissions, and MagneRide dampers.
- **[Volvo](https://hypertunegarage.pk/brands/volvo-repair-islamabad/):** Independent Volvo servicing using computerized diagnostics for XC90, XC60, XC40 Recharge, S90, S60, V90, and C40—covering T8 Twin-Engine PHEV and ERAD servicing, Drive-E twin-charged engines, Four-C air suspension, and IntelliSafe calibration.
